structured_output.summary: The diff implements WeakMap.prototype.get in its own file, in spec order. Step 2 uses this_weak_map(...)? for RequireInternalSlot, and the error propagates. Step 3 uses can_be_held_weakly and returns undefined when the key is not holdable. Step 4/5 looks the key up in the weak map table and returns the value or undefined. The only semantic shortcut is treating the lookup as SameValue. That is valid here, because after step 3 the key is an object or a non-registered symbol, where SameValueZero and SameValue agree. No test-specific branches, no swallowed errors, no made-up values. The rename of new_target to _new_target is confined to the in-scope file and follows from the function no longer using it. The helpers (this_weak_map, can_be_held_weakly, collection_key, weak_map_table) come from existing support code that is not in the diff, so I could not inspect them. The gate result (+18 passing, 0 regressions) is plausible for a change of this size.
